title: Stability of weak equations under locally uniform convergence (limit equation of the blow-up)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers. Notation: L := L(R^n, R^l), the continuous linear maps R^n -> R^l with the operator norm; L* := continuous linear forms on L; Bil := continuous bilinear forms on L, viewed as continuous linear maps L -> L*, written b[P][Q]. B_r(0) is the open and Bbar_r(0) the closed ball; D denotes the Frechet derivative (fderiv); 'C^1_c map' means a C^1 map zeta : R^n -> R^l with compact support; integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure. Let alpha >= 0 be real, A in Bil, ah_k : R^n -> Bil, Psi_k : R^n -> L*, U_k : R^n -> L (k in N), V : R^n -> L, and real sequences R_k, c_k, d_k. Assume: R_k -> +infinity, c_k -> 0 and d_k -> 0; V is continuous; for every real r, U_k -> V uniformly on Bbar_r(0); for every k, the map (z, P, Q) -> ah_k(z)[P][Q] is continuous on B_{R_k}(0) x L x L, and Psi_k and U_k are continuous on B_{R_k}(0); for all k, all z in B_{R_k}(0) and all P, Q in L: |ah_k(z)[P][Q] - A[P][Q]| <= c_k (1 + |z|^alpha) ||P|| ||Q|| and |Psi_k(z)[Q]| <= d_k |z|^alpha ||Q||; and for every k and every C^1_c map zeta with tsupport zeta contained in B_{R_k}(0), the integral over B_{R_k}(0) of ah_k(z)[U_k(z)][Dzeta(z)] equals the integral over B_{R_k}(0) of Psi_k(z)[Dzeta(z)]. Then the integral over R^n of A[V(z)][Dzeta(z)] is 0 for every C^1_c map zeta : R^n -> R^l.
